verification_scope: Complete fresh Packages.xz downloads match the committed signed-index hashes and byte counts. Package floors use real dpkg ordering. This is package-index evidence, not a built image scan or a new signature-verification execution.
image_scope: Controller requires the Perl floor; viewer requires all three floors. Both recipes upgrade inherited packages from the pinned closure and reject unreadable/below-floor installed versions. Actual replacement image security, bootstrap, byte confidentiality and capability evidence remain separate required gates.
